This is not linked to the widget's OFF button. While trusted conditions apply, other people can also use the phone. First-time and periodic re-authentication are required.

Hermes only checks whether the phone is currently locked. It does not show whether Extend Unlock is active or how long it lasts.

While ON, the microphone and an on-device voice model run. Waiting audio is never saved or sent. When \"Hey Hermes\" is detected, only the request recording goes to Hermes speech recognition, using the connected conversation and the configured voice. Listening does not start if the host cannot guarantee a safe model setup. After a reply you can keep talking for 30 seconds without the wake word; silence returns to waiting. \"Stop\" ends the conversation and OFF stops the microphone and playback. If the phone is locked, Android\'s unlock screen appears and the request waits up to 2 minutes; it continues after you unlock and is discarded if you cancel. Voice is not a way to verify your identity.
